test_title: PYST 146: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 01 Feb, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All mobiles are computers.

Some computers are furniture.

Some furniture are tables.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tables are computers.

II. Some mobiles are furniture.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db787344c399d2e90b6ba2828d565d3b420cafae24d315cd649303a7dcb63a0d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tables are computers → Does not Follow (As, some computers are furniture and some furniture are tables. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

II. Some mobiles are furniture → Does not Follow (As, all mobiles are computers and some computers are furniture. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion I nor II follows"**.
